references.text: Continuation of the laws concerning flying swarming creatures, providing exceptions for certain insects with jumping legs and elaborating on the prohibition against unclean flying creatures.
General prohibition against eating swarming creatures (שֶׁרֶץ), expanding the principle that crawling things are unclean.
Parallel law in Deuteronomy declaring all flying swarming creatures unclean, based on the same principle that they are forbidden to eat.
Previous paragraph concerning unclean birds, providing context for the laws about flying creatures in general.
Uses the same word שֶׁקֶץ (abomination) in connection with unclean animals and ritual impurity.
